instruction: I want to enable 'Do Not Track' in Chrome to tell websites not to track my browsing. How do I turn this on?

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt install jq -y
cd /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && jq '. + {"session":{"restore_on_startup":4, "startup_urls":["http://funbrain.com/"]}}' Preferences > temp && mv temp Preferences

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling 'Do Not Track' in Chrome settings. Similar complexity - navigate to Settings > Privacy and security > Security and enable 'Send a Do Not Track request'.
